description: Read a file in a Fudge draft: a theme file, a theme folder listing, or a content document under .entities (list with .entities/product?query=…). Each line starts with a gutter ending at its first tab, numbered on the first, last and every tenth line; long files return `line_offset`. Theme files return a `revision`. Append #info to see where a theme file is used.

char_offset.description: Character offset within a very long first line, only when the result says to continue with one.

line_limit.description: Lines to return. Omit to read up to the limit.

line_offset.description: 0-based line to start from, from a previous read.

path.description: A theme file such as sections/main-product.liquid or templates/product.json, or a content document such as .entities/product/123.jsonc or .entities/page/45.body.html.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: read_draft_file
title: Read draft file
